name: goto_next
description: Go to the next label in the script, relative to this command.

name: goto_first
description: Go to the first label with this ID in the script.

name: label
description: A label that can be jumped to by many commands. The script will then continue executing from here.

name: yield
description:
Stop the execution of the script for this frame, then resume it on the next frame.

This command needs to be used once in a loop to prevent the script from getting stuck inside a loop forever. Can also be used to pause for a frame, to split processor-heavy tasks into mulitple frames to prevent slowdowns.

name: endlist
description: This must be used once at the end of every script.

name: set_ailist
description: Set the given character's script.

name: set_returnlist
description:
Set the given character's return script. This script can then be jumped to by the "008 - Go to return script" command.

A common use of this command is to set this to the current script, then go to a new script, which will then use the return command to jump back to the old script.

name: set_shotlist
description:
Set the current character's shot script. This script will be jumped to when the character is shot, and starts from the beginning.

This is commonly set to the current script, so the character continues executing it even when shot.

name: return
description: Jump to the return script that was set by the command "006 - Set character return script".

name: stop_chr
description: Make the current character stop any animations, which includes walking and running.

name: kneel
description: Make the character perform a kneeling animation.

name: chr_do_animation
description:
Make the character perform the selected animation.

Start frame: Set to 0 or higher to start the animation from that specific frame; set to -1 for the first frame (same as 0); set to -2 for the last frame.

End frame: Set to 0 or higher to end the animation on that specific frame; set to -1 to end on the last frame.
Blend time: The time it takes from one animation to gradually blend into the new one; from 0 to 255.
Animation speed: set to 2 for normal speed; 1 for fast animation; 4 for slow animation.

name: if_chr_idle
description: If the character performs any animation that is set by the command "00B - Character does animation", go to label.

name: be_surprised_one_hand
description: Makes the character perform an animation where they raise one hand in the air.

name: be_surprised_look_around
description: Makes the character perform an animation where they look around in surprise.

name: try_sidestep
description: Makes the character try to perform a sidestep. If it succeeds, go to label. The action may fail if the guard is blocked.

name: try_jumpout
displayname: Current character tries to jump sideways
description: Makes the character try to jump sideways. If it succeeds, go to label. The action may fail if the guard is blocked.

name: try_run_sideways
displayname: Current character tries to run to the side
description: Makes the character try to run to the side. If it succeeds, go to label. The action may fail if the guard is blocked.

name: try_attack_walk
displayname: Current character tries to walk and attack
description: Makes the character try to do a walking attack. If it succeeds, go to label. The action may fail if the guard is blocked or cannot see the target.

name: try_attack_run
displayname: Current character tries to run and attack
description: Makes the character try to do a running attack. If it succeeds, go to label. The action may fail if the guard is blocked or cannot see the target.

name: try_attack_roll
displayname: Current character tries to run and attack
description: Makes the character try to do a rolling attack. If it succeeds, go to label. The action may fail if the guard is blocked or cannot see the target.

name: try_attack_stand
displayname: Current character tries to stand and attack
description: Makes the character try to do a standing attack. If it succeeds, go to label. The action may fail if the guard is blocked or cannot see the target.

name: try_attack_kneel
displayname: Current character tries to kneel and attack
description: Makes the character try to do a kneeling attack. If it succeeds, go to label. The action may fail if the guard is blocked or cannot see the target.

name: try_modify_attack
displayname: Try to modify attack flags for current character
description:
Modifies the attack flags for the character.

This command can only be used after the commands 015, 016, 018 and 1BA. Those commands are commonly used with the "Aim only" attack flag, and if the label was followed, this command is used with the attack flags unset, making the character shoot.

name: try_face_entity
displayname: Current character tries to face target
description: Makes the character try to face their target. If it succeeds, go to label. The character only stops facing if a significantly different command is given to them, or the command "009 - Current character stops moving" is given to them.

name: damage_chr
description: Damages the character with the given weapon stats.

name: chr_damage_chr
description: Makes the character damage the other character with its weapon. There is no animation or bullets being fired, and the character don't even need a line of sight to each other.

name: consider_throwing_grenade
description: Makes the character consider throwing a grenade, based on the grenade probability property. If the guard throws the grenade, go to label. The two values are currently unknown.

name: drop_item
description: Makes the character spawn and immediately drop the given item.

name: jog_to_pad
description: Makes the character jog to the given pad.

name: go_to_target_pad
displayname: Current character goes to target pad
description: Makes the character go to their assigned pad preset.

name: walk_to_pad
description: Makes the character walk to the given pad.

name: run_to_pad
description: Makes the character jog to the given pad.

name: assign_path
description: Assign the given path to the character to patrol on. The character only starts patrolling if command 22 is assigned.

name: start_patrol
description: Makes the character start patrolling on the path that they were assigned to by command 21.

name: if_patrolling
description: Checks if the character is patrolling on a path.

name: surrender
description: Makes the character throw up their hands and surrender.

name: drop_gun_and_fade_out
displayname: Current character drops gun and fades out
description: Makes the character fade out and disappear, and drop their gun.

name: remove_chr
description: Removes the given character completely from the stage.

name: try_start_alarm
displayname: Current character tries to sound alarm
description:
Makes the character run to the pad and try to sound the alarm.

This command checks if the object at the pad is healthy. If the object is not an alarm switch, the character runs to the nearest alarm switch instead.

name: activate_alarm
description: Makes an alarm sound play for 30 seconds (vanilla G5 Building has 55 seconds).

name: deactivate_alarm
description: Makes the alarm sound stop playing.

name: try_run_from_target
displayname: Current character tries to run from target
description: Makes the character run 1000 units in the opposite direction of their current target, without pathfinding. If the character encounters a wall, they stop.

name: try_jog_to_target
displayname: Current character tries to jog to target
description: Makes the character jog to their current target.

name: try_walk_to_target
displayname: Current character tries to walk to target
description: Makes the character jog to walk current target.

name: try_run_to_target
displayname: Current character tries to run to target
description: Makes the character run to their current target.

name: try_go_to_cover_prop
displayname: Current character tries to go to cover prop
description: Does nothing in the base game, due to a bug. Was meant to make the character go to a suitable prop for cover.

name: try_jog_to_chr
displayname: Current character tries to jog to character
description: Makes the character try to jog to the given other character.

name: try_walk_to_chr
displayname: Current character tries to walk to character
description: Makes the character try to walk to the given other character.

name: try_run_to_chr
displayname: Current character tries to run to character
description: Makes the character try to run to the given other character.

name: if_chr_stopped
description: Checks if the character has stopped moving or animating.

name: if_chr_dead
description: Checks if the given character is doing their death animation, has finished their death animation, or is invalid.

name: if_chr_death_animation_finished
displayname: If character's death animation has finished
description: Checks if the given character has finished doing their death animation.

name: if_can_see_target
displayname: If current character can see their target
description: Checks if the character can see their assigned target. This considers the characters field of vision, fog, the target's cloak, and the like.

name: call_rng
description: Calls the random number generator to generate a number from 0 to 255.

name: if_rand_lt
displayname: If random number is less than
description: Checks if the number generated by command 36 is less than the given value.

name: if_rand_gt
displayname: If random number is greater than
description: Checks if the number generated by command 36 is greater than the given value.

name: if_can_hear_alarm
description: Checks if the alarm is sounding. This is the same as command 3A, but was probably meant to have extra checks.

name: if_alarm_active
description: Checks if the alarm is currently active.

name: if_gas_active
description: Checks if gas has been released from a gas bottle prop. This is different from the gas released in Escape. Gas bottles and this command are a leftover from GoldenEye.

name: if_hears_target
displayname: If the current character has heard their target
description: Checks if the character has heard their target, e.g. due to gunfire.

name: if_saw_injury
displayname: If the current character sees someone injured
description:
Checks if the character sees another character being injured.

Check type: If 0, check all teams and reset "injury seen" flag; if 1, check the same team and do not reset "injury seen" flag.

name: if_saw_death
displayname: If the current character sees a death
description:
Checks if the character sees another character dying.

Check type: If 0, check all teams and do not reset "death seen" flag; if 1, check the same team and reset "death seen" flag; if 2 and greater, check all teams and reset "death seen" flag.

name: if_los_to_target
displayname: If current character has line of sight to target
description: Check if the character has a line of sight to their assigned target. The direction the current character faces is irrelevant, but cloak is considered.

name: if_target_nearly_in_sight
displayname: If current character has line of sight to target with buffer
description: Check if the character has a line of sight to their assigned target, or would have one if the target moved the given distance.

name: if_nearly_in_targets_sight
displayname: If target has line of sight to current character with buffer
description: Checks if the assigned target has a line of sight to the current character, or would have one if the current character moved the given distance.
